A '''SCAV''' was a light emplacement weapon particularly useful against [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] craft. Several were employed by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] to [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|defend]] his [[Nym's Base|base]].
